decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding Lord Francis Hill's spouse. Document 1 (D1) presents a historical account stating he was married to Ishabel MacDougall, citing census data, parish registers, and historian testimony (D1S2, D1S8, D1S9). Document 2 (D2) presents a narrative account where Lord Francis Hill is thinking of his wife, Janet Halyburton, Lady Dirletoun (D2S4). As per the instruction to preserve distinct valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without a definitive resolution mechanism in the source text, both names are included as valid answers derived from the respective source contexts.
